limitations: Customer Leaf build and full customer content-pack composition were not reproduced.
No real client visual/selection-outline validation was performed.
Chunk-load regression directly invokes the FD listener on an already loaded CE chunk, not a disk unload/reload cycle.
Tray regression exercises the skillet; no separate cooking-pot native placement case was added.
26.10 was tested on the native server in this revision; the 926-unit-test rerun used 26.9.2.
